eps.ov: The bright and positive Sonny Wright along with his passionate teammates make the difficult decision of leaving their island home to continue their one joy in life; soccer.
Sonny and the new Raimon Eleven struggle to understand the training given to them by their odd manager, Mister Yi.
The odd methods continue as Mister Yi gears the Raimon team up for their first official match against the school with an incredible defense, Rampart Jr. High.

eps.t: Will It Fall?! The Impregnable Fortress
eps.ov: The day is finally here. It's Raimon vs Rampart and Mister Yi is still up to his strange tactics.
Though an incredible striker, Elliot Ember fails to command his teammates' respect due to his inconsistent attendance and performance.
Things heat up as Polestar Academy goes against Kirkwood Junior High. Renowned Flame Striker, Axel Blaze, leads Kirkwood players with great teamwork and powerful moves.

eps.t: The Light That Comes into Sight
eps.ov: With Elliot's evolution into a dependable ace striker, Polestar Academy finally finds its footing against Kirkwood.
The Raimon Eleven are left on their own against the analytical team, Anima Sana, in the 3rd round prelim.
The diabolical Ray Dark is once again the commander of the Royal Academy team, despite being previously condemned.

eps.t: Clash! Emperor Penguin VS Polar Bear!!
eps.ov: The morale of Royal Academy starts to fall apart when the players find out Ray Dark's dishonest approach.

eps.t: The Night Before the Battle, Asuto's Decision
eps.ov: Sonny feels lost about his motive for playing soccer. Then, he receives a letter from his late mother with a message that may change everything.
In the final match of the preliminaries, it's once again Raimon vs Polestar.

eps.t: Fierce! The Final Stage of the Storm!!
eps.ov: Determined to crush Raimon, Elliot's onslaught is relentless. However, even with Sonny's injured leg, the eleven stand firm.
The Football Frontier finals begin and the story of the mysterious Heath Moore is about to unfold.
Elliot's chance for revenge is here as Polestar faces off against Lunar Prime.

eps.t: The Double Prince of the Snowfield
eps.ov: Raimon may be facing their toughest opponents yet - Alpine Jr. High. Alpine Jr. High is a refined school from the north, known for their top strikers.
Here to shake things up, Bunny Cottontail has entered the field. An unpredictable force, Bunny is a beginner at the game but an incredibly fast learner and runner.
Raimon's next opponent is the brilliant Alia Academy, but Alia faces their own darkness.
With Hunter on the bench, Alia Academy is in trouble.

eps.t: The Ultimate Technique, Its Name Is...
eps.ov: Xavier blasts through as a one-man show, but soccer is a team sport. To have a chance at winning this game Hunter will have to convince Xavier to trust his teammates.
The Raimon Eleven are on cloud nine from reaching the semi-finals, that is until they hear they'll be facing the legendary goalie and captain, Mark Evans.
Under the legendary Mark Evans, Everytown Junior High has become a formidable opponent. Maxime must rise to the occasion and bring the Raimon Eleven together.
Now that Maxime has stepped up and rallied the team, the Raimon Eleven are back in business.
The final showdown between Raimon and Lunar Prime is almost here, but illness and injury plague both teams.
It's the final battle: Raimon vs. Lunar Prime. Will Heath and Elliot be able to overcome their animosity and play honestly? This heated match is just getting started.
The second half is under way and it's the fiercest fight yet. With Sonny, Elliot, and Heath all aiming for victory, who will come out on top?
